text: Tenstorrent Blackhole accelerates tiled tensor programs.
LoRA adapts a frozen language model with low-rank matrices.
A deterministic checkpoint contains model, optimizer, and progress state.
Sequence packing reduces padding while preserving causal boundaries.
The execution planner selects schedules from semantics and geometry.
PEFT adapters can be saved and reloaded without the development source tree.
The doctor command verifies device, driver, runtime, and compiler readiness.
Useful-token throughput excludes padding that does not train the model.
